book.name: Sekan Kranakuls
book.title: Sekan Kranakuls Ola Stori Blanga Ola King Blanga Juda

content: Shemaiya bin gedim mesij brom YAWEI

Wal wen King Reiyabowam bin kamat deya langa Jerusalem, imbin jingat en majurrumap 180,000 brabli gudwan solja brom det dubala klen gulum Benjamin en Juda. Imbin wandi go langa wo en jidan bos igin blanga detlot pipul brom det nowathsaid kantri langa Isreil.
Bat YAWEI det trubala God bin dalim det speshalwan mesinja gulum Shemaiya blanga gibit dijan wed langa King Reiyabowam, en langa detlot pipul blanga det Benjamin klen en det Juda klen.

YAWEI bin tok, “Yumob nomo go en fait langa yumob ronwan femilimob, ola Isreil pipul. Yumob ol gobek langa yumob ron kantri na. Mi na bin meigim dis ting hepin.” Wal deibin teiknodis langa YAWEI en olabat nomo bin fait garram King Jerabowam.
King Reiyabowam bin meigim detlot taun jidan strongbala

King Reiyabowam bin jidan langa Jerusalem en imbin meigim brabli strongbala ol dislot taun langa Juda en Benjamin, Bethlahem, Itam, Tekowa, Bethsuwa, Sako, Edulam, Geth, Maresha, Sif, Edaraiyim, Leikish, Esaka, Sora, Ejalan en Hebran.
Afta imbin meigim detlot taun brabli strongbala imbin pudum ola boswan solja lida langa ebri taun en imbin gibit daga, oliboil en wain langa ebriwan,
en imbin pudum shild en spiya deya du. Imbin jidan king blanga Juda en Benjamin na.
Ola serramonimen en ola Libaimen bin kaman langa Juda
Wal brom oloba langa det kantri gulum Isreil, ola serramonimen en ol detlot Libaimen bin kaman sauthwei langa Juda blanga albumbat King Reiyabowam.

Detlot Libaimen bin libum olabat fam en olabat bin go langa Juda en Jerusalem, dumaji King Jerabowam brom Isreil, en detlot king hubin kaman afta im nomo bin larram detlot serramonimen dum det wek blanga YAWEI deya langa Isreil.
King Jerabowam bin pikimat serramonimen blanga im blanga wek langa detlot pleis weya deibin oldei weshipbat detlot dibuldibul en drimin sheip deibin meigim jis laik buligi.
Bat sambala Isreil pipul bin wandim weship YAWEI laik olabat grengrenfathamob bin dum, en deibin bulurrum detlot Libaimen langa Jerusalem, wulijim olabat gin gibit sekrifais ofring langa YAWEI.

Fo 3 yiya deibin album King Reiyabowam det san blanga Salaman en deibin meigim det kantri blanga Juda jidan brabli strongbala. Deibin wek gudwei blanga im laik deibin dum langa King Deibid en King Salaman bifo.
Femili blanga King Reiyabowam
Wal King Reiyabowam bin merrit langa det gel neim Mahalath. Im dedi bin Jerimath hubin san blanga Deibid, en im mami bin Ebiheil det doda blanga Eliyab en grendoda blanga Jesi.
Dubala bin abum thribala san neim Jeyus, Shemaraiya, en Seiham.
Bambai King Reiyabowam bin merrit langa Meiyaka det doda blanga Ebsalom, en deibin abum fobala san neim Abaija, Etai, Sisa en Shelomith.
King Reiyabowam bin abum 18 waif en imbin abum 60 mowa gel, en imbin jidan dedi blanga 28 san en 60 doda. Brom ol detlot waifmob imbin laigim Meiyaka brabliwei,
en imbin laigim det san blanga Meiyaka neim Abaija brabliwei. Imbin pikimat im blanga jidan det nekswan king.

King Reiyabowam bin sabi gudwei en imbin meigim im sanmob jidan bos blanga ola strongwan taun langa Juda en Benjamin. Imbin gibit olabat blendibala ebrijing en imbin faindim sambala waif blanga olabat.
